units.title: The nature and variety of living organisms
units.paper: Biology Paper 1 and Paper 2; Science (Double Award) Biology Paper 1

points.text: 1.1 Living organisms share eight characteristics: nutrition, respiration, excretion, response, movement, internal control, reproduction, growth.
1.2 Common features of eukaryotes: plants, animals, fungi, protoctists, with the named examples.
1.3 Prokaryote features: bacteria have cell wall, membrane, plasmids, circular DNA, no nucleus; Lactobacillus and Pneumococcus.
1.4 Pathogens include fungi, bacteria, protoctists and viruses; viruses are non-living, with a protein coat.

units.paper: Biology Paper 1 and Paper 2; Science (Double Award) Biology Paper 1
